entities.name: NADH dehydrogenase subunit 2
observations: The 583-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein Q35140 from Neurospora crassa.
Homolog annotations identify it as a core membrane subunit of respiratory-chain Complex I.
Predicted and homolog-supported localization is the mitochondrial inner membrane; it is a multi-pass membrane protein.
The sequence contains Pfam Proton_antipo_M (PF00361.26), spanning residues 157-479, consistent with a proton-translocation membrane module.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight approximately 65.7 kDa, theoretical pI 8.86, and high hydropathy (GRAVY 0.794).

entities.name: Respiratory chain complex I
observations: The protein is annotated as a core subunit of mitochondrial NADH dehydrogenase (Complex I), participating in respiratory electron transport and ATP synthesis coupled electron transport.
Complex I transfers electrons from NADH toward ubiquinone while contributing to the proton-motive force through its membrane arm.

entities.name: Mitochondrial inner membrane
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate this protein as a multi-pass component of the mitochondrial inner membrane.
